delta_z_chain.source: ROSbot XL and RPLIDAR S3 technical drawings (user-supplied, 2026-09-23 capture configuration)

stereo floor-plane fit on data_2026-09-23 rectified pairs: tools/lidar_ground_truth/camera_height_from_stereo.py -> results/lidar_ground_truth/data_2026-09-23/camera_height_from_stereo.json (median of 23 captures, std 0.8 mm)

attitude_instrument: Not independently measured. Relative LiDAR-to-camera pitch/roll assumed zero because both sensors share the robot's mounting attitude (user, 2026-09-23). Camera absolute attitude from the ZED 2i IMU (session_manifest.json reference_attitude: roll 0.062 deg, pitch 0.057 deg, stated accuracy +-0.5 deg); stereo floor-plane tilt 0.33 / 0.27 deg. Tolerance set to the IMU's +-0.5 deg.
notes: Rig parameters for the ROSbot XL + ZED 2i + RPLIDAR S3 rig as captured in data_2026-09-23. The LiDAR is mounted below the camera. delta_z_m = z_scan_plane_above_floor - z_camera_optical_centre_above_floor = 0.1748 - 0.2220 = -0.0472 m (sign convention, PLAN.md Sec 1.2: height of the LiDAR scan plane above the rectified left camera optical centre in frame R, positive = LiDAR higher). delta_z_tolerance_m 0.005 is the RSS of the drawing tolerance (3 mm), the stereo height's scale uncertainty (about 3 mm: a 1.4 % scale ambiguity is present in this session's board-plane data, see results), and carpet-pile / wheel-contact ambiguity between the drawing's ground and the stereo-observed floor (about 2 mm). measurement_status is 'estimated' rather than 'measured' because neither height is a caliper metrology chain (PLAN.md Sec 3.1). board_standoff_m is 0 because the checkerboard is free-standing and the LiDAR strikes the printed board face that solvePnP locates, not a wall behind it.
